newsitem.title: EGYPT: ING Barings helping set up Cairo brokerage firm.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings helping set up Cairo brokerage firm.

text.p: London-based international securities house ING Barings will take a share in a new Cairo brokerage in partnership with local companies, executive Mohamed Abdullah of brokers Intercapital said on Monday.

The Egyptian partners include Commercial International Investment Company (CIIC), the investment affiliate of Commercial International Bank, and Mansour and Maghraby, an investment group with diverse interests.
Intercapital, a brokerage company set up by defectors from the dominant Cairo brokerage company EFG-Hermes, will provide the management, Abdullah said.

Abdullah said he believed ING Barings would be the first foreign securities house to take a direct stake in an Egyptian brokerage. The new brokerage does not yet have a name and it is awaiting final approval by the Capital Market Authority.
